active_continuity: Jin Taekyung's party has found Dong Feng, the Divine Physician and Mungyeong's Master, in a hidden clinic in Sichuan.
The clinic is concealed by a Mystic Gate Formation installed by the ancient Master of Strange Illusions.
Dong Feng has begun treating Venerable Myoryeong and says she can fully recover after the remaining treatment and sufficient rest.
Jeok Cheongang has been brought to Dong Feng for treatment, but the result remains unknown; he is still critically ill.
Tang Taesang was murdered, and Tang Sadok continues pursuing the culprit with members of the Sichuan Tang Clan.
The Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun, the Emei Sect Leader, and three Emei Elders were killed on Mount Emei by a one-armed middle-aged man.
Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau's Young Bureau Head while investigating its traitors; Song Ilseom remains for one month to help her before seeking Ju Hogun's elixir in Xianyang.
open_questions: Will Dong Feng successfully treat Jeok Cheongang before his illness becomes fatal?
Will Venerable Myoryeong complete treatment and recover from the Black Hand Seal?
Who is the one-armed middle-aged killer, what is his purpose, and is he connected to Tang Taesang's murder?
Which other Yongbong Escort Bureau members collaborated with Heo Jun, and how will the Zhongnan Sect's leaders and wider organizers respond?
temporary_decisions: Render 경천신니 as Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and 혈나찰 as Blood Rakshasa.
Render 흑수인 as Black Hand Seal and 사공 as evil technique in this medical context.
Render 입적 as passed into nirvana for the death of a Buddhist nun.
Render 악귀 as demon or demon incarnate according to whether it functions as a general description or a direct characterization.
Render 동봉 as Dong Feng, 동 노인 as Old Man Dong, 기문진 as Mystic Gate Formation, and 기환노사 as Master of Strange Illusions.
